note: Current-season MLB lines lifted verbatim from the eephus.io leaderboards. This site derives no wRC+ and no xFIP of its own, so neither is served here: HEM+ is the offense-rate index it does compute, and Skill FIP, SEM+ and REM+ are the run-prevention numbers. The fip field is Skill FIP, the sample-shrunk FIP with a starter-pool or reliever-pool constant that SEM+ and REM+ are built on, and not the standard FIP; the key keeps its name so existing readers do not break. The MLB Stats hitter board does show a wRC+ column, but that figure is MLB's published wRC+ displayed verbatim rather than anything this site derives, and it is deliberately not carried in this payload.
